objective: Recover stalled/expired Community Wall video playback like Facebook while preserving one-visible-player, IMA ads, cache, web and photo behavior
productionBaselineEvidence: Android photo OTA #231 verified update 01a18c87-79eb-7216-b8e6-9aac47cacf4b, source 89492344511e602ba060c4b69d47cf3d7450728f, runtime 1.3.2. This proposal is a separate unshipped video change. Public Wall refreshes expired video URLs on playback error, scoped Wall does not. expo-video statusChange error does not forward to parent. Current player unmount/offscreen, 256 MB bounded LRU, and IMA separate path already exist.
chosenApproach: On Expo-video player error, attempt one same signed URL replay to preserve cached byte ranges; after that fails, invoke parent recovery at most once. Scoped Wall renews protected Supabase or AWS video URL with bounded in-flight dedupe and updates only matching post/media URI. Leave native IMA, web, and photo pipeline unchanged.
alternativeApproaches: Rotate signed URL immediately on every buffering error (rejected: loses cache and creates signing storms)
Replace Expo player with native IMA for all videos (rejected: changes ad system and requires new APK)
Rebuild all Community and Connect video components in one release (rejected: unrelated regression risk)
selectionRationale: Small safe shared error path and scoped URL parity; retains native player caching and autoplay controls, bounded retries and access isolation.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Photo OTA #231 and production release unchanged
Google IMA ads and native monetization untouched
All authored content, video Storage and Supabase RLS unchanged
Offscreen/unmounted players do not auto replay
One-visible-video autoplay and 256 MB video cache retained
Only same-post matching signed URL replaced in scoped feed
acceptanceChecks: An active failed Expo video makes only one replay before calling URL recovery
No repeated error callbacks after one signed URL renewal request
Public Wall existing URL rotation receives callback
Scoped Supabase and AWS Wall posts obtain signed URL renewal no more than twice per mounted scope
DEV->verified RC->Production OTA only after all gates and exact release evidence
